# watchpoint_domain_monitor (Resource)

A domain registration monitor: reads expiry, registrar and nameservers from the registry (RDAP, WHOIS fallback) and alerts before the domain lapses or when its delegation changes. Checks daily by default. Requires the `domain_monitors` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Warn 45 days before the registration expires, go critical at 10, and flag any
# registrar or nameserver change.
resource "watchpoint_domain_monitor" "primary" {
  name                 = "example.com registration"
  domain               = "example.com"
  expiry_warning_days  = 45
  expiry_critical_days = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Registered domain name, for example `example.com`. Internationalised names are stored as punycode; a difference only in letter case is not drift.
- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.

### Optional

- `alert_on_nameserver_change` (Boolean) Warn when the delegated nameservers change. Defaults to `true`.
- `alert_on_registrar_change` (Boolean) Warn when the registrar changes. Defaults to `true`.
- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Plans cap the minimum.
- `expiry_critical_days` (Number) Go critical within this many days. Must not exceed `expiry_warning_days`. Defaults to `7`.
- `expiry_warning_days` (Number) Warn when the registration expires within this many days. Defaults to `30`.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check. Hosted regions only: private locations refuse this monitor type.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor. Requires the SLA monitoring feature. When omitted the monitor keeps whatever it has, which on create is the tenant's default SLA profile if one is set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries. Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Check timeout in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Registration expiry seen on the last check (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `last_check_status` (String) Status of the last check (`Success`, `Warning`, `Critical`, ...), or null.
- `nameservers` (String) Comma-separated nameservers seen on the last check.
- `registrar` (String) Registrar seen on the last check.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_domain_monitor.primary mon_dom_001
```
